title: UnsubscribeSmsInput
description: Send the opt-out keyword once to each distinct sender number for a subscription service. Offered for every subscription (STOP when the text does not name a keyword), including ones that also have an unsubscribe or manage-subscription link. Sent only after you confirm; exactly this text goes to exactly these numbers.

service.title: Service
service.description: Company or service these texts are from (for example Cash App).

recipients.title: Send to
recipients.description: Each distinct sender number for this service. The keyword is sent once to each, after you confirm.

keyword.title: Text that will be sent
keyword.description: Carrier-standard opt-out keywords only. STOP is used when the text does not name one.
